# Fractal Infinity

Fractal Infinity maps the emerging ASI economy so people can see what is changing, what is constrained, and where the next advantage is forming.

Canonical site: https://fractalinfinity.io

Positioning: Frontier intelligence, applied.

## What it is
An intelligence platform for the emerging ASI economy. Broader than a media brand, newsletter, research lab, or forecasting site.

Includes:
- frontier research
- ecosystem mapping
- bottleneck analysis
- forecasts
- simulation
- applied experimentation
- interactive tools
- agent-oriented machine-readable intelligence

## Primary topics
- artificial intelligence
- compute
- semiconductors
- memory
- photonics
- robotics
- quantum systems
- energy
- manufacturing
- datacenters
- autonomous agents
- bottlenecks
- dependencies
- opportunity discovery

## Operating method
capability → dependency → constraint → breakthrough → consequence → opportunity

Also:
Map the system → Detect the change → Find the constraint → Trace the consequence → Surface the opportunity → Record the outcome
